instructions.instruction: Load the four parcels onto the cart, push it to the sorting tables, then place the yellow parcels on the left tables and the white parcels on the right tables.

subtask_steps.instruction: First pick up all four parcels and place them on the cart, holding one parcel in each hand at a time.
Push the loaded cart in front of the sorting tables.
place both white parcels on either of the two tables on the right.
place both yellow parcels on either of the two tables on the left
